_comment: Keys whose translation is CORRECTLY byte-identical to the English source.
Why this file exists (ROADMAP Task 161): generate_translation_payloads.php counts a value
that equals English as 'equal_to_english' delta. For the keys below that is permanently
wrong by design, not by neglect, so the delta count could never reach zero and every sprint
proposal had to re-derive the same hand-classification from scratch. With this file, delta
SCOPE: this suppresses ONLY the equal_to_english reason. A key listed here that is MISSING
or BLANK in a lang file is still reported as delta -- exemption says 'identical is allowed',
never 'this key does not need a value'.
'languages': '*' means every language; an explicit array means only those languages may
legitimately land on the English string. Use the array form for coincidental cognates -- a
global exemption there would hide a genuinely untranslated string in an unrelated script.
A language added later is therefore reported until someone confirms the cognate holds.
NOTE ON THE $ec_lang_intent 'symbol' TAG: it is NOT a usable exemption source and was
rejected as the mechanism here. 'symbol' means 'keep the symbols inside this string intact',
not 'this whole string is a symbol' -- ip_notes_1_def, ip_notes_2_def and wi_notes_we_def
carry the tag and are full prose that must be translated. Only 2 of the 7 symbol-only keys
below even carry the tag. An explicit list is the honest mechanism.

bpn_id.reason: ID -- node identifier column heading, used as a symbol.

bpn_method_hw.reason: Hazen-Williams -- surnames are never renamed (CLAUDE.md, Simple English section).

bpn_source_label.reason: 'Source' is the French word, spelled identically -- and is the hydraulic sense here, not a false friend.

calc_units_si.reason: SI -- Systeme International, an international abbreviation by definition. Same button pair as calc_units_us.

calc_units_us.reason: US -- the unit-preset button. All 26 languages independently kept it in the Task 166 sprint; it is the international abbreviation for the customary system and renders in a narrow button beside SI.

contact_main_menu.reason: 'Contact' is the French word, spelled identically.

dw_regime_laminar.reason: 'Laminar' is the correct word in these languages. Others (fr laminaire, it laminare, cs/hr laminarni) genuinely differ, so this is not a global exemption.

dw_regime_turbulent.reason: 'Turbulent' is the correct French word, spelled identically -- the sibling of dw_regime_laminar above, which fr does NOT share (laminaire). Task 146.06 sprint, 2026-08-08.

dw_roughness.reason: e -- absolute roughness symbol; identical in every language and script.

ec_name_placeholder.reason: 'Name' is the German word, spelled identically. Not global: es Nombre, fr Nom, it/pt Nome, ru Imya, tr Ad.

install_android_heading.reason: Android (Chrome) -- product names. Languages that transliterate into their own script are still free to; this only permits the identical form.

install_desktop_heading.reason: 'Desktop' is the ordinary word in German, Indonesian and Italian; Chrome/Edge are brands. Not global: es Escritorio, fr Ordinateur, pt Computador, ru/uk/bg/cs/hr/sr each use their own word, zh 桌面版.

install_ios_heading.reason: iOS (Safari) -- product names, same reasoning as install_android_heading.

ip_hf.reason: h_f -- friction head loss symbol; carries the intent 'symbol' tag.

ip_hm.reason: h_m -- minor (local) head loss symbol; carries the intent 'symbol' tag.

ip_press.reason: 'Press.' is the natural abbreviation of Pression / Pressao in a narrow column heading, and matches the suite's own incumbent bpn_p_down ('Press. av.'). Task 146.06 sprint, 2026-08-08.

lpn_ago_minutes.reason: '{n} minutes' is identical in French, placeholder and all. Not global: es/pt minutos, tr dakika. Task 146.06 sprint, 2026-08-08.

lpn_color_example_material.reason: 'Material' is the natural word in these languages; Indonesian degraded it to 'Bahan' to pass this check before the exemption existed.

lpn_color_example_status.reason: 'Status' is the natural word in these languages; a synonym would read as worse.

lpn_dialog_ok.reason: OK -- the dialog confirm button. Scoped, NOT global: these seven languages use bare "OK" as the conventional button label, but 19 others translate it (zh 确定, tr Tamam, es Aceptar, hr U redu, uk Гаразд, sw Sawa), so a global exemption would hide a genuinely untranslated string. Added 2026-08-13 after the wave-4 cs agent correctly found the key already present and correct.

lpn_ex_elm_street_title.reason: Elm Street Center -- a proper place name for the example site, not translated.

lpn_ex_net1_title.reason: EPANET Net1 -- the sample network's own name, as EPANET itself calls it.

lpn_ex_net2_title.reason: EPANET Net2 -- the sample network's own name, as EPANET itself calls it.

lpn_ex_net3_title.reason: EPANET Net3 -- the sample network's own name, as EPANET itself calls it.

lpn_field_auto.reason: 'Auto' is the ordinary short form in Spanish, French and Italian software UI, and this is a narrow toggle label where the English is deliberately short. Not global: pt Automatico, tr Otomatik. Confirmed by the es and fr agents in the Task 146.06 sprint, 2026-08-08, and by the it agent in the Task 251 sprint, 2026-08-13. Added sw, Task 251 wave 3, 2026-08-13: Latin script, so this is NOT the script-contamination defect that made hi and de fail here, and Swahili has no false-friend collision (a car is gari, not auto). The sw agent declared the choice explicitly as asked, reasoning that Otomatiki does not fit a narrow toggle and that Auto is the field register -- consistent with this project's finding that Tanzanian engineering practice is English-medium. Flag for native review; a native reader could still prefer Otomatiki.

lpn_field_diameter.reason: Diameter -- the same word in Indonesian (KBBI). Scoped to id; other languages inflect or spell it differently.

lpn_field_id.reason: ID -- the same node-identifier heading as bpn_id above, and the same symbol. Task 146.06 found tr had rendered it 'Kimlik' while its own bpn_id stayed 'ID'; aligned to the incumbent per the concept-level label reuse convention.

lpn_field_lat.reason: 'Latitude' is spelled identically in several Latin-script languages and is the exact scientific term; no synonym exists.

lpn_field_lon.reason: 'Longitude' is spelled identically in several Latin-script languages and is the exact scientific term; no synonym exists.

lpn_field_text_align_center.reason: 'Centre' is the French spelling and is identical to the English source's own.

lpn_menu_edit.reason: Edit -- 'edit' is an absorbed Indonesian verb (KBBI, cf. mengedit) and the ordinary menu label. Kept where the sibling lpn_tool_file was changed to Berkas, because 'file' has a settled native alternative in Indonesian localization and 'edit' does not. Flag for native review.

lpn_new_text.reason: Text -- the default contents of a newly placed text label. Same word and same evidence as lpn_tool_add_text. Added ro, Task 251 wave 3, 2026-08-13: text is the ordinary Romanian noun and OK is universal; the ro agent kept them while translating every other Latin-script term, and its one genuine false cognate (Auto, which reads automotive in Romanian) was caught separately and changed to Automat.

lpn_pump_point1.reason: 'Point 1' -- 'Point' is identical in fr and several others, and the numeral is a numeral.

lpn_scenario_base.reason: 'Base' is a real word in each of these, with this exact sense, and it is a scenario's proper NAME on screen. Sprint 316 (2026-08-14): four Romance agents arrived at it independently.

lpn_scenario_base_value.reason: 'Base: {value}' -- follows lpn_scenario_base, since it reuses that scenario's name verbatim. Only the punctuation and placeholder surround it.

lpn_scenario_label.reason: 'Scenario' is ITALIAN; English borrowed it. Translating it into anything else would be the error. Sprint 316.

lpn_scenario_new_name.reason: 'Scenario {n}' -- same word as lpn_scenario_label plus a number.

lpn_settings_page.reason: 'Page' is identical in fr and several others.

lpn_time_pause.reason: 'Pause' is standard UI vocabulary spelled identically in fr, de and others.

lpn_time_tank.reason: 'Tank' is the established German term for this element, per the glossary.

lpn_tip_join.reason: '{name} - {tip}' is two placeholders and a separator. There is nothing to translate; the separator is a per-language choice and matching English is one valid answer.

lpn_tool_add_reservoir.reason: Reservoir -- the German water-engineering term is the same word, and the de agent chose it deliberately in Task 251 while picking Hochbehaelter for the variable-level tank lpn_ does not model, so the documented pair stays distinct. Indonesian likewise borrows 'reservoir' as its standard civil-engineering word (KBBI); its Task 251 agent confirmed it against bpn_h_supply_tip already in the file.

lpn_tool_add_tank.reason: 'Tank' is the standard German word for a water storage vessel, and is deliberately distinct from 'Reservoir' (lpn_tool_add_reservoir) so the two toolbar buttons read as two elements. Sprint 316.

lpn_tool_add_text.reason: Text -- the text-tool button. 'Text' is the ordinary word in Czech and German; their Task 251 agents chose it deliberately, 2026-08-13. Added ro, Task 251 wave 3, 2026-08-13: text is the ordinary Romanian noun and OK is universal; the ro agent kept them while translating every other Latin-script term, and its one genuine false cognate (Auto, which reads automotive in Romanian) was caught separately and changed to Automat.

lpn_tool_file.reason: File -- the File menu label. Scoped to Italian, whose Task 251 agent chose it deliberately and where it is the standard menu label. Add a language only on the same evidence.

lpn_valve_type_tcv.reason: Indonesian pipework practice says 'katup throttle' -- 'throttle' is a standing loanword with no distinct native term, so the label keeps it. Sprint 316.

mhp_vel_ok_short.reason: 'OK' is the ordinary Brazilian-Portuguese form in a narrow verdict column. Not global: es/fr Bien, tr Tamam, ru Horosho, zh and ar each use their own word.

mi_groupPoint.reason: 'Point' is the French word, spelled identically.

mi_groupSegment.reason: 'Segment' is the French word, spelled identically.

mtc_pi_ok_tip.reason: '0.28-0.36 ft (Phillips & Ingersoll, 1998)' is two numbers, the unit token these five languages themselves use for foot (each one's own u_ft is 'ft'), and two surnames -- nothing in it can legitimately change. Not global: comma-decimal languages render 0,28-0,36 (id, pt and sr were corrected to the comma 2026-08-05) and ru/zh translate the unit word.

u_depthFrac.reason: 'Fraction' is the correct French word, spelled identically. Surfaced only when Task 163 taught the validator to read double-quoted assignments -- this key had never been checked. Not global: es fraccion, it frazione, pt fracao, ro fractie, de Anteil all genuinely differ.

u_imgd.reason: IMGD -- imperial million gallons per day. Sibling of u_mgd ('MGD'), which needs no entry because ecIsUniversalKey() auto-exempts a u_ key whose English has no run of four letters. IMGD has exactly four, so it falls off that heuristic by one character while meaning the same kind of thing. Several languages do render it (Mgal imp/dia, Mgal imp/j, Mgal imp/Tag) and exemption does not stop them -- it only says that keeping the Latin abbreviation, as many scripts do for unit symbols, is a legitimate answer rather than an untranslated string.
